description: Module-neutral catalogue of the domain events the notification box can route. One row per event: the module that owns it, the actors a producer will send with it, the placeholder vocabulary its templates may use, and the channels it may be routed to. The Configurator reads it to drive the event picker, the audience picker's Actor list and template validation BEFORE any event of that type has ever been seen. PGR's rows are GENERATED from the workflow definition by local-setup/scripts/generate_event_catalogue.py -- do not hand-edit them.

module.description: Owning module, e.g. Complaints. Recorded verbatim on the thin event and used by the Configurator to group and filter.

eventName.description: The globally unique, dotted, module-prefixed event key, e.g. COMPLAINTS.WORKFLOW.ASSIGN.PENDINGATLME. Replaces the legacy (businessService, action, toState) tuple.

entityType.description: What the event's entityId names, e.g. COMPLAINT.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the Configurator's event picker.

actors.description: The actor names a producer sends on this event. Feeds the audience picker's Actor list: an audience of ACTOR:<name> is resolvable only for a name declared here.

name.description: Actor key as it appears in the thin event's actors map, e.g. citizen, assignee.

required.description: true = the producer always sends this actor; false = it may be absent, so an audience that depends on it needs a fallback in its pipe chain.

placeholders.description: The {token} vocabulary this event carries. A template may only use tokens listed here; anything else ships with literal braces.

name.description: Token name WITHOUT braces, e.g. complaint_type.

blankWhen.description: When this token resolves to an empty string rather than a value. Authoring hint only.

channels.description: Channels this event may be routed to. A module may declare EMAIL-only events.

description: Module-neutral notification routing (the 'who'): one row per (eventName, audience, channel) declaring that this domain event notifies that audience over that channel. Joins 1:1 with NOTIFICATIONS.Template on (eventName, audience, channel). Replaces RAINMAKER-PGR.NotificationRouting, whose businessService is subsumed by eventName, whose fromState was documentation-only, and whose assigneeOnly is now expressed by the audience chain ACTOR:assignee|ROLE:<code>.

module.description: Owning module, e.g. Complaints. NOT part of the uniqueness key -- eventName is already globally unique -- it exists so a row's owner is visible without a join.

eventName.description: Event key from NOTIFICATIONS.EventCatalogue, e.g. COMPLAINTS.WORKFLOW.ASSIGN.PENDINGATLME.

audience.description: Recipient reference with a scheme. ACTOR:<name> resolves from the event's actors map with no I/O; ROLE:<code> expands to every holder of the role in the tenant; EVENT_RECIPIENTS reads the event's recipients array; A|B is a pipe chain taking the first form that yields a non-empty list. Legacy bare names still resolve: CITIZEN=ACTOR:citizen, EMPLOYEE=ACTOR:assignee, any other bare name=ROLE:<it>. AUTO_ESCALATE and SYSTEM are non-notifiable and dropped with a warning.

description: Module-neutral notification content (the 'what'). One row per (eventName, audience, channel, locale) holding the message body the notification box renders per recipient locale. Replaces RAINMAKER-PGR.NotificationTemplate. Edited via the configurator.

module.description: Owning module, e.g. Complaints. Not part of the uniqueness key; see NOTIFICATIONS.Routing.module.

audience.description: The audience this body is written for, in the same scheme form the matching NOTIFICATIONS.Routing row uses. The two must be byte-identical or the routing row finds no template.

body.description: Message body with {placeholder} tokens. A token the event does not carry is left unsubstituted (literal braces).

placeholders.description: Declared {tokens} this body uses. Must be a subset of the event's catalogue vocabulary.

description: Module-neutral provider template mapping (the 'how it is delivered'): one row per (provider, channel, eventName, audience, locale) mapping a rendered notification to the external provider's pre-registered template and its ordered variables (e.g. a Twilio Content SID for WhatsApp). Replaces RAINMAKER-PGR.NotificationProviderTemplate. Carries no module column: it is keyed by the provider's own registry, and eventName already names the owner.

provider.description: External delivery provider whose template registry this row targets, e.g. twilio.

audience.description: Same scheme form as the matching NOTIFICATIONS.Routing / NOTIFICATIONS.Template rows.

templateId.description: Provider-side template identifier, e.g. a Twilio Content SID (HX...).

templateName.description: Human-readable provider template name, for reference in the configurator.

variables.description: Ordered {token} names substituted into the provider template positionally.

approvalStatus.description: Provider approval state of the template, e.g. approved, pending, rejected.

description: Per-tenant notification channel policy (the 'is this channel on, and through which gateway'): one row per channel. Read by novu-bridge at the STATE tenant on every dispatch (cached 60s). Shape unchanged from RAINMAKER-PGR.NotificationChannel, which it replaces; only the namespace moves. Edited via the configurator (Notifications -> Channels).

enabled.description: false = every event on this channel is recorded SKIPPED/NB_NO_PROVIDER, never delivered.

gateway.description: Transport. novu (default) delivers through the Novu integration for the channel; smscountry (SMS only) posts straight to SMSCountry's bulk API.

senderId.description: Registered sender id / DLT header for a direct SMS gateway. Ignored for novu.

provider.description: Novu integration identifier of the ACTIVE provider for this channel at this state tenant (one per channel). Set/cleared from the configurator (Notifications -> Providers); credentials live in Novu, never here. Empty/absent = no provider selected. Nullable like senderId so clearing the selection is a valid write.
